name: paper-search
description: Academic paper search across PubMed, arXiv, and Semantic Scholar — all zero-key. 'all' merges sources and dedupes by title. Returns ids (PMID/arXiv/S2), authors, year, abstract, url, pdf, doi.
use_when: finding peer-reviewed papers or preprints by topic

args.name: --max N
args.description: Cap results per source and total (default 10).

args.name: --year-min N
args.description: Only papers from year N onward.

env.S2_API_KEY: Optional Semantic Scholar key — lifts the keyless rate limit.

stdout: JSON {results: [{source, id, title, authors, year, abstract, url, pdf, doi}]}.

exit_codes.1: no results or a single-source search failed
